Importation
The government shall hereby
facilitate
the importation
of sugar at sixty five percent (65%) tariff to
address the expected shortfall
in production

Sugar
Importation
Guidelines.
The guidelines
cover, among others,
the following:
(a) quantity of sugar that shall be
imported per tranche; (b) the amount of fees that shall be collected fro.m
the importers;
(c) deadline(s) for the sugar importation
per tranche; and
(d) posting of a performance
bond by importers, callable on demand, to
ensure the faithful
and prompt undertaking
of the importation
All sugar that shall be imported following the guidelines prepared
by the Committee shall be classified as "B" (domestic use) sugar.

Reporting
Requirement.
The SRA shall monitor
domestic sugar situation
and shall submit through the DA, bi-monthly
reports to the President on the matter.
Before the end of the year 2000,
the CSCA shall report to the President the amount of fees that had been
collected from the importation
and how such fees had been allocated.
All orders, issuances
thereof which are inconsistent
with this Executive
Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.
Effectivity.
This Executive Order' shall take effect
immediately
and shall be effective be until December 31, 2000, unless
repealed, modified or amended accordingly.
DONE in the City of Manila, Philippines, this ~
day of July in
the year of our Lord, Two Thousand.
